subtasks.description: Generate preprocessor `define` statements for all configuration macros listed in the spec table, including mutual exclusivity comments and default selections for groups such as BIG_ENDIAN/LITTLE_ENDIAN, SIM/SYN, and SD_CLK_* options.
constraints: Ensure only one macro per exclusive group is actively defined; comment out or deactivate alternatives.
Use specified valid value ranges; for derived parameters like BD_WIDTH or ADR_SIZE, compute correct log2 expressions as comments or helper defines.
